name: Spear-phishing & targeted mail defence
tagline: Lookalike-domain discovery → impersonated-mail inspection → takeover ledger, composed from the first-party suite. Enforcement stays on the private authority; this surface only describes.

components.role: Continuously enumerates the attack surface an impersonator can use — lookalike domains, exposed mail gateways, leaked executive detail — and hands attack paths plus asset context to the VM ledger.

Inspects received mail — headers, domain normalisation (punycode, homoglyph, added characters), sender alignment (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) and URL rewrite targets — and emits targeted-mail findings to the VM ledger in the shared finding-schema.

Consumes the four first-party detectors' findings in the shared schema, dedups and scores takeover and impersonation events, and tracks them through the remediation lifecycle (detected → in progress → verified → closed).

boundary: This surface only describes the defence. Enforcement stays on the private authority.
